revolver.name: REVOLVER
revolver.description: A six-shot revolver built around timing, recoil, loaded-round order, and strong knockback.

moves.name: FIRE
moves.description: Fire the next round. The revolver must finish its spin before it can fire again.

moves.name: RELOAD
moves.description: Reload missing normal rounds. Reloading grants 10 temporary health and 15% damage reduction for 1 second.

moves.name: CHARGED LOAD
moves.description: At full charge, dump the cylinder and load six charged rounds with extreme recoil.

wand.name: WAND
wand.description: A space-control weapon that throws persistent stars through walls and fighters.

moves.name: STAR
moves.description: Fire a spinning star that passes through walls and fighters, damaging each fighter once.

moves.name: HOMING STARS
moves.description: Fire three small stars with slight homing. They fade away after a few seconds.

moves.name: BURST STAR
moves.description: At full charge, fire a large pass-through star that bursts into twelve smaller stars on its first terrain impact.

sake.name: SAKE
sake.description: A stance weapon built around drinking, slips, buffs, charge, and a chaotic drunk state.

moves.name: DRINK / GOURD THROW
moves.description: Drink once every 5 seconds. Each drink fills one of 8 drunk slots and grants one random buff. At 8 slots you automatically become drunk. While drunk, LMB throws the gourd and causes bleed.

moves.name: SAKE SPIT / SAKE SPILL / DRUNK SWING
moves.description: For 5 seconds after drinking, spit a messy fading cone from the fighter's body. Without a mouthful, spill sake and create a damaging slip puddle. While drunk, swing the gourd toward the nearest enemy.

moves.name: CHUG
moves.description: Chug after at least 5 drinks, or at full charge. Enter a 15 second drunk state with moderate offense/defense boosts and stronger movement.

dagger.name: DAGGER
dagger.description: Fast dagger with cloak, bleed, and reckless movement.

moves.name: LUNGE
moves.description: Floppy blade-first rush toward the mouse. 3s cooldown.

moves.name: THROW
moves.description: Spin-throw the dagger. Bleeds 3s, or 6s while cloaked. 5s cooldown.

moves.name: CLOAK
moves.description: Cloak for 8s. First 4s are invulnerable. 17s cooldown.

mushroom.name: MUSHROOM
mushroom.description: Spore spray and green mushrooms that briefly make the opponent dizzy.

moves.name: SPORE SPRAY
moves.description: Spray four short-range spores. Each hit deals light damage and briefly causes dizziness with occasional reversed movement.

moves.name: GREEN MUSHROOMS
moves.description: Requires 50 charge and consumes it on use. Launch four seeds that grow into green mushrooms on landing. Touching a mushroom deals more damage and causes dizziness.

moves.name: PURPLE MUSHROOMS
moves.description: Requires full charge and consumes it. Four seeds grow into purple mushrooms. Moving above any one detonates all of your purple mushrooms, spraying spores, dealing heavy nearby damage and causing brief dizziness and a purple screen vignette. All disappear after bursting.

cleaver.name: CLEAVER
cleaver.description: Heavy two-hit melee weapon with a wound-up cleave and recoverable charged throw. Hemorrhage lasts 5 seconds, increases damage taken by 20%, and deals 1 HP per second.

moves.name: UPWARD / DOWNWARD SLASH
moves.description: Alternate upward and downward sweeps. Each hit has a 12.5% chance to cause Hemorrhage.

moves.name: WIND-UP CLEAVE
moves.description: Wind up for 0.7 seconds, then rush toward the cursor and cleave. Knocks the opponent back and guarantees Hemorrhage. Leaves a dark red trail.

moves.name: CHARGED CLEAVER THROW
moves.description: Hold E to charge range and damage. Throw a gravity-affected cleaver. It embeds in a target or surface, damages an embedded target over time, and must be picked up to attack again. Pulling it out of an opponent causes Hemorrhage.
